usageNotes: Use this endpoint to enumerate all prepared auto-installer answer configurations stored in PDM, which are matched against incoming PXE/network boot requests to drive unattended Proxmox installations. Requires the System.Audit privilege on the system/auto-installation path — read-only tokens are sufficient. Note that several fields (fqdn, mailto, cidr, gateway, dns) may contain MiniJinja template expressions rather than literal values; they are resolved at install-time, not at retrieval time.

examples.summary: List all prepared auto-install answer configurations

tips: Only one configuration can have is-default set to true; its target-filter is ignored — it catches any installation not matched by a more specific configuration.
Configurations with authorized-tokens restrict which API tokens may retrieve that answer at install time; an empty list means any token can retrieve it.
disk-mode determines whether disk-list (fixed) or disk-filter (dynamic udev matching) is active — check both fields when reviewing a configuration.
MiniJinja template counters in template-counters auto-increment on each instantiation, enabling unique FQDNs or IPs across bulk deployments without editing the configuration.
